# The Naming Problem

At least three naming conventions are used for BWI data:

- the old Thuenen Institute names
- the new Thuenen Institute names
- the WEHAM / FVA-BW names

A conversion table between the old and new Thuenen Institute names is available
in the [migration documentation](https://thuenen-forest-ecosystems.github.io/TFM-Documentation/api/migration.html).
It does not include the WEHAM / FVA-BW names.

The following table should explain how the FVA-BW names are related to the new Thuenen names:





| Thuenen API schema  | Thuenen API table | New Thuenen Institut Name       | WEHAM / FVA-BW Name | WEHAM table                               |
| ------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `interval_name`                 | Not exported        | Used to select the inventory interval     |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `cluster_name`                  | `Tnr`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`, `WEHAMI_Jung`, `WEHAMI_Eck` |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `plot_name`                     | `Enr`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`, `WEHAMI_Jung`, `WEHAMI_Eck` |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `federal_state`                 | `Bl`                | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `acquisition_date`              | `DatumFeld`         | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `property_type`                 | `Eg`                | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `property_size_class`           | `Grkl`              | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `management_type`               | `Be`                | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `harvest_restriction`           | `Ne`                | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `stand_layer_regeneration`      | `BsP100`            | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `stand_layer_regeneration`      | `BsP175`            | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `plot`            | `stand_layer_regeneration`      | `Bs`                | `WEHAMI_Jung`                             |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `stand_layer`                   | `Bs`                | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `tree_species`                  | `Ba`                | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `tree_number`                   | `Bnr`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `stem_breakage`                 | `Kh`                | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `stem_form`                     | `Kst`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `tree_height`                   | `Hoe`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `stem_height`                   | `StHoe`             | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `tree_age`                      | `Al_ba`             | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `inventory_archive` | `regeneration`    | `tree_species`                  | `Ba`                | `WEHAMI_Jung`                             |
| `inventory_archive` | `regeneration`    | `tree_size_class`               | `Gr`                | `WEHAMI_Jung`                             |
| `inventory_archive` | `regeneration`    | `tree_count`                    | `Anz`               | `WEHAMI_Jung`                             |
| `inventory_archive` | `tree`            | `dbh`                           | `Bhd`               | not used - derived.tree.dbh is used       |
| `derived`           | `tree`            | `dbh`                           | `Bhd`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `derived`           | `tree`            | `diameter_30perc`               | `D03`               | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| `derived`           | `tree`            | `trees_per_hectare`             | `N_ha`              | `WEHAMI_WZP`                              |
| Function argument   | Not an API table  | `share_of_natural_regeneration` | `NatVjProz`         | `WEHAMI_Eck`                              |

**Additional details:**

`WEHAMI_Jung.Bs`, `WEHAMI_Eck.BsP100` and `WEHAMI_Eck.BsP175` are all derived from the same value: `plot.stand_layer_regeneration`

`Bs` refers to different sources depending on the WEHAM table. `Ba`
represents tree species in both tables:

- `WEHAMI_WZP.Bs`  stands for `tree.stand_layer`
- `WEHAMI_Jung.Bs` stands for `plot.stand_layer_regeneration`
- `WEHAMI_WZP.Ba`  stands for `tree.tree_species`
- `WEHAMI_Jung.Ba` stands for `regeneration.tree_species`

`NatVjProz` is supplied by the user through the function argument and is assigned to every exported plot; it is not downloaded from an API column.
`interval_name` is used as a filter and is not written to the three WEHAM tables.
The generated columns `BsP175` and `NatVjProz` keep these names even when
`rename = FALSE`.
